Start and stop a fasting timer, set a goal, and review your recorded fasts. Edit entries to correct start and end times and keep a record of your fasting history.

Features

- Fasting timer: see elapsed time and the time remaining until your chosen goal.
- Widgets and Live Activities: check your timer from your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island on supported devices.
- Apple Watch: start and finish fasts, change your goal, and check your current fasting status from your wrist, included for free.
- Fasting history: add, edit, and review your recorded fasts.
- Charts and trends: explore fasting durations, totals, and averages over time.
- Notifications: choose reminders and alerts for your timer and eating window.
- Siri and Shortcuts: start and finish fasts and check your current fasting status.
- CSV import and export: import existing records or export your data for use outside the app.
- Dark Mode: use a light or dark appearance to suit your preference.
- Streaks and badges: view summaries and milestones based on your recorded fasts.

Additional paid features are available through one-time purchases and auto-renewable subscriptions. Available options, included features, and prices are shown in the app before purchase. name: Shotsy GLP-1 Tracker
description:
Shotsy is the all-in-one GLP-1 medication tracker for weight loss injections and pills. Track doses of Ozempic®, Wegovy®, Wegovy™ Pill, Mounjaro®, Zepbound®, Rybelsus®, Saxenda®, Victoza®, and Trulicity® — all in one app. Whether you take semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, dulaglutide, or retatrutide, Shotsy helps you stay on schedule and reach your goals.

DOSE TRACKING
Log injections or daily pills with a single tap. Track your full medication history, side effects, weight, calories, protein, and water intake. Supports multiple simultaneous medications with separate schedules for each.

SMART SCHEDULING & REMINDERS
Set precise schedules for weekly injections or daily oral doses. Get countdowns, reminders, and next-dose notifications so you never miss a dose.

ESTIMATED MEDICATION LEVELS
See how your medication levels change over time with charts based on peer-reviewed clinical data. Available for semaglutide (Ozempic, Wegovy, Wegovy Pill, Rybelsus), tirzepatide (Mounjaro, Zepbound), liraglutide (Saxenda, Victoza), and dulaglutide (Trulicity).

DETAILED ANALYTICS
Gain insights into your progress with interactive charts and visualizations. Track weight trends, side effects, nutrition, and more.

APPLE HEALTH INTEGRATION
Automatically import weight, calories, protein, and water intake from Apple Health for a complete picture of your health journey.

PRIVACY FIRST
Your personal data is securely stored on your device and synced across your devices using Apple's private iClou
